title: 讲过去的事
goal: 会说昨天、上周末、上次旅行做了什么，听懂 Did you ...? / What did you ...? 并用过去式回答。
tips: 过去式多数加 -ed：watch → watched，play → played；常用的不规则：go → went，eat → ate，see → saw，have → had，buy → bought。
问过去：Did you ...? / What did you do ...? 后面的动词用原形：Did you go? 不是 Did you went?
讲故事的连接词：first, then, after that, finally。

words.zh: 有过；吃过（have 的过去式）

exchanges.hear: What did you do last weekend?
exchanges.reply: I went hiking with some friends.

exchanges.hear: Did you have a good holiday?
exchanges.reply: Yes, I had a great time in Yunnan.
exchanges.replyZh: 很好，在云南玩得很开心。

exchanges.hear: When did you start learning English?
exchanges.hearZh: 你什么时候开始学英语的？

exchanges.hear: Did you see the game last night?
exchanges.reply: Yes! What an amazing goal at the end!
exchanges.replyZh: 看了！最后那个进球太精彩了！

exchanges.hear: What did you have for dinner?
exchanges.reply: I ate some dumplings at home.

exchanges.hear: Where did you buy that jacket?
exchanges.reply: I bought it online last month.
No, I stayed home and watched TV.

lines.en: It was great, thanks. I went to the beach with my family.
lines.zh: 很好，谢谢。我和家人去海边了。

lines.en: Nice! What did you do there?
First, we swam in the sea. Then we had a barbecue.
lines.zh: 先在海里游泳，然后吃了烧烤。

lines.en: A little, but we found a quiet spot. How about you?
lines.zh: 有一点，不过我们找到一个安静的地方。你呢？

lines.en: I stayed home and finally cleaned my apartment.
lines.zh: 我待在家，终于把公寓打扫了。

lines.en: Yes. And on Sunday I saw a movie with my sister.
lines.zh: 是啊。星期天我还和我妹妹看了场电影。

lines.en: A new comedy. It was really funny.
